Orbital
Definition · canonical

Capacity is the self-reported availability of personal resources.

Orbital records it. It does not interpret it, explain it, score it, or tell you what to do about it. That restraint is the product, and the rest of this page is the list of things it therefore is not.

What capacity is not

Nine refusals, in the doctrine's own words

Carried verbatim from CAPACITY_DOCTRINE.ts. Each one closes a door a competitor walked through.

a mood
Moods are emotional experiences. Capacity is resource availability.
an emotion
Emotions are affective responses. Capacity is a functional signal.
a symptom
Symptoms suggest underlying conditions. Capacity suggests nothing.
diagnostic
It does not indicate, suggest, or screen for any condition.
energy
Not "energy" in the colloquial wellness sense. Not vitality or enthusiasm.
productivity
It does not measure output, performance, or achievement.
wellbeing
It makes no claim about quality of life or flourishing.
stress
Stress is a response to demands. Capacity is resource availability.
fatigue
Fatigue is a sensation. Capacity is a self-assessment.
a wellness app
No lifestyle recommendations, habit coaching, or self-improvement features.
a productivity tool
No task management, time tracking, or efficiency optimization.
a mental health platform
No therapy, counseling, crisis intervention, or clinical workflows.
a symptom tracker
No medical symptom logging, medication reminders, or health monitoring.
a social network
No feeds, likes, shares, comparisons, or community features.
a gamified experience
No points, badges, leaderboards, or achievement systems.
What it does instead

Three things, all descriptive

Neither advises, recommends, interprets, or prompts. That is the line, and staying on the descriptive side of it is a market position rather than a limitation.

Capacity
You say where you are

A self-report, recorded and kept. Non-causal by design: it does not explain why capacity is at a given level, because explaining would be interpreting.

Schedule
Appointments, held plainly

A calendar is not a clinical workflow. Orbital holds what is scheduled and shows it against what you recorded. It draws no conclusion from the pair.

Absence
A gap is also a signal

Days you did not record are shown as days you did not record — never inferred, never filled in, never counted against you.

Why the list above is permanent

The prohibitions are held in a file marked Status: FROZEN · Effective: Permanent · Classification: Infrastructure Law. They are not a roadmap of things not built yet. They are things that will not be built.

A personal-assistant surface — medication tracking and life coaching — was proposed for Orbital on 2026-09-12 and withdrawn rather than shipped against this law. The law was not amended, narrowed, or unfrozen to make room for it.
